mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CODEF_TOKEN (service_type, client_id, access_token, expires_at) VALUES (#{serviceType}, #{clientId}, #{accessToken}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT codef_token_id AS id, service_type AS serviceType, client_id AS clientId, access_token AS accessToken, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM CODEF_TOKEN WHERE service_type = #{serviceType} AND client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY codef_token_id DESC LIMIT 1
